description: HPO terms for the 20 danon checklist items (configs/checklists/danon.json), chosen on 2026-10-20 by a Claude helper from the pinned HPO release by name and synonym search and hierarchy checks (pipeline/extract/hpo_lookup.py), D-40. 'observed' is the one term a record may assert when the item is observed; null where the item is a composite no single term covers exactly (the free-text feature rows carry the specific term). 'excluded' lists every term a record may mark excluded when the item is explicitly absent. Flagged for review by Jimmy or the panel; not a pre-registered choice.

left ventricular hypertrophy.note: Left ventricular hypertrophy; exact name match.

dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle (r.note: Composite: Left ventricular dilatation and Left ventricular systolic dysfunction (hypokinesis; Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction HP:0012664 is its descendant). No single term covers dilated or hypokinetic; Abnormal left ventricular function is broader (includes outflow obstruction, diastolic dysfunction).

right ventricular hypertrophy.note: Right ventricular hypertrophy; exact name match.

left ventricular outflow tract obstructi.note: Left ventricular outflow tract obstruction; exact name match.

late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac M.note: Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement, the LGE the item's quotes describe; absence of LGE on CMR also excludes Pericardial late gadolinium enhancement. Their common parent (Abnormal cardiac MRI finding) is broader than the item.

ventricular pre-excitation (short PR, de.note: Ventricular preexcitation (Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome is a descendant; no delta-wave term exists) and Shortened PR interval, which is not under preexcitation in HPO, so a short PR alone cannot be asserted as preexcitation; observed null.

atrioventricular block.note: Atrioventricular block; first-, second- and third-degree blocks are descendants.

supraventricular tachycardia (atrial fib.note: Supraventricular tachycardia, Atrial fibrillation, Atrial flutter; in HPO the atrial arrhythmias are not descendants of Supraventricular tachycardia, and their common parent Supraventricular arrhythmia is broader (premature atrial contractions, atrial standstill).

ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation.note: Ventricular tachycardia (under Tachycardia) and Ventricular fibrillation (under Ventricular arrhythmia); Ventricular arrhythmia is broader (PVCs, preexcitation) and is not an ancestor of VT.

proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopa.note: Proximal muscle weakness; the parenthetical is read as a gloss. Skeletal myopathy (HP:0003756) is not listed because absent weakness does not imply absent myopathy.

elevated creatine kinase.note: Elevated circulating creatine kinase activity (EXACT synonym 'Elevated creatine kinase').

intellectual disability, cognitive impai.note: Composite: Intellectual disability, Cognitive impairment and Specific learning disability (HPO has no general 'learning difficulties' term); none is an ancestor of another.

developmental delay (including delayed m.note: Neurodevelopmental delay, parent of Global developmental delay (EXACT 'Developmental delay') and Motor delay (EXACT 'Delayed motor milestones'); it also covers speech and social-milestone delay.

attention deficit disorder or ADHD.note: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (EXACT synonyms 'Attention deficit disorder' and 'ADHD') covers both.

mood or anxiety disorder.note: Composite: Depression, Bipolar affective disorder and Anxiety; HPO has no 'mood disorder' term, and Abnormal emotional state is broader (euphoria, emotional dearth).

pigmentary retinopathy or retinal dystro.note: Composite: Pigmentary retinopathy and Retinal dystrophy (Cone/cone-rod dystrophy is a descendant); pigmentary retinopathy is not under retinal dystrophy.

elevated liver enzymes (transaminases).note: Elevated circulating hepatic transaminase concentration (EXACT synonyms 'Elevated liver enzymes', 'Elevated transaminases'); ALT and AST elevation are descendants.
